eval/runner/cat40/loop.ts.note: loop.ts at main d8a01dfd: the unused loop hooks in the next-wave confirmation's drift note (docs/plans/2026-10-11-cat40-next-wave/PREREG.md; eval/runner/cat40/next-confirm.ts driftNote), plus the Q1 file agent's loop changes that reached main with the Q1 scoreboard (#122, 2026-10-28; 1aa5854e, c6b85de0, 905b01c0, 033663c0): an opt-in reasoning effort, a check that the answer tool is named submit_answer, and one usage normalizer (eval/runner/q1/usage.ts) that fills the same token buckets. Cat 40 passes no effort, so its request bodies are unchanged and no model cell changes.

loop.ts with the particle-1 provider branch (plan GST-605 Phase 3, unit U8): particleLoop beside anthropicLoop and openaiLoop, provider attempts that carry the turn and the request fields sent, and runAgentText refusing particle-1. The claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol request bodies and retry timing are byte-identical to main's (test/eval/cat40-particle-loop.test.ts), so no Anthropic or OpenAI cell changes.

loop.ts with the particle turn fixes of fix wave 2 (issues #253 and #271): a particle request is sent with compatDeadlineMs (the upstream deadline, or on a loopback lease-proxy slot that deadline plus the proxy's longest admission wait) and Bun's fetch timeout off, a particle 504 is never sent again, and a run that ends on a turn Particle may have billed records timed_out. Only the compat branch changed: the claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol fetch init, request bodies and retry timing are unchanged (test/eval/cat40-particle-loop.test.ts), so no Anthropic or OpenAI cell changes.

loop.ts with the particle 2xx fix of fix wave 2 (issue #280): a particle answer with status 2xx and no choices[0].message, or a body that is not JSON, is recorded with any usage it reported and thrown at once as a ProviderError with its 2xx status, so the run ends with timed_out instead of sending the turn up to five more times as a server error. On a Hard run that session ends as error, as a timed-out particle turn does; after six sends it used to end as harness_error, which a Hard run retries. Only the compat branch of postJson changed: the claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol request bodies and retry timing stay pinned by test/eval/cat40-particle-loop.test.ts, so no Anthropic or OpenAI cell changes.

loop.ts at main ef3200db for the newest-build re-measure (docs/benchmarks/2026-11-19-cat40-hard-newest-preregistration.md): OpenAI agent requests are stateless (store false, encrypted reasoning items, the whole conversation resent, no previous_response_id; 1b7d5cfe), so a gpt-6.2-sol cell sees the same conversation through a different request shape; each response is priced as the budget ledger settles it, cache writes and long prompts included (ab2e1142); billing refusals are classified when classifyStops is set (494951d4, a0c8e228); and particle-1 report fixes (bd7d30b2, 2fa9e8ac). Anthropic request bodies are unchanged. No stored cell is paired with a new one: every arm reruns on new worlds.

loop.ts for the old-build control (docs/benchmarks/2026-11-19-cat40-hard-old-build-control-preregistration.md): Anthropic and OpenAI runs record each distinct model id the provider said served a turn (the response's model field) as served_models, which Hard attempts keep under each session's run. Request bodies, retries, pricing and the particle-1 path are unchanged (test/eval/cat40-particle-loop.test.ts pins the bodies; test/eval/cat40-hard-old-build-control.test.ts pins the recording). No model cell changes.

loop.ts at main a4c8bee28 (#538): Anthropic and OpenAI requests retry every provider 5xx a resend can fix (all but 501 and 505), such as Cloudflare's 520, where they used to retry only 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 and 529, and every 5xx or 429 that ends a run is classified harness_error, the preregistrations' definition. Request bodies, pricing and the particle-1 path are unchanged (test/eval/cat40-particle-loop.test.ts; test/eval/cat40-hard-fail-closed.test.ts pins the retries). A cell that used to end on such a status unretried now gets the retry its preregistration asks for; no stored cell changes.
